title: Designing for the Next Click: Bandits for Real-Time Page Layout
abstract: arXiv:2608.29850v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: E-commerce platforms increasingly personalize user experiences through machine learning, yet page layout decisions remain dominated by static rules and manual curation. We present a scalable bandit-based system that optimizes product page layouts in real time while preserving human control over design intent. A contextual bandit model dynamically selects the most effective layout for each session using user, item, and category-level features. The system leverages a LinUCB-based policy to balance exploration and exploitation as it learns from live user interactions. The architecture is designed for seamless integration into large-scale web serving stacks, supporting low-latency inference and continuous model updates. The system was first tested on entry product pages. In online A/B deployments on a major retail platform, our approach achieved positive lifts in session-level performance metrics over a strong heuristic baseline. Our results

translated_title: 为下一次点击而设计：用于实时页面布局的多臂老虎机方法
translated_abstract: 电商平台日益通过机器学习实现用户体验的个性化，然而页面布局决策仍然主要依赖静态规则和人工策划。我们提出了一种可扩展的基于多臂老虎机的系统，能够实时优化商品页面布局，同时保留人类对设计意图的控制。该上下文老虎机模型利用用户、商品和品类级别的特征，动态地为每个会话选择最有效的布局。系统采用基于LinUCB的策略，在从真实用户交互中学习的过程中平衡探索与利用。该架构设计为可无缝集成到大规模Web服务栈中，支持低延迟推理和持续的模型更新。该系统首先在商品入口页面上进行了测试。在一家大型零售平台的在线A/B测试部署中，我们的方法相比强大的启发式基线，在会话级性能指标上取得了正向提升。
tldr: 提出了一种基于LinUCB上下文多臂老虎机的实时页面布局优化系统，在保留人工设计意图控制的同时，动态为每个用户会话选择最优商品页布局，并在大型零售平台的在线A/B测试中取得了显著的正向效果。
en_tdlr: A scalable LinUCB-based contextual bandit system that optimizes product page layouts in real time while preserving human control over design intent, achieving positive lifts in session-level metrics in online A/B deployments on a major retail platform.
